text:
leo-ops: Noticing EU GPU pool failing to pull model blobs after last night's endpoint harden. Nodes stuck in pull phase -> nodejoin timed out, 3/8 healthy.

ayn-sre: Error in node-agent logs: `epoch=2026-03-24T02:05:12Z level=error pull failed: s3:GetObject AccessDenied; kms:EncryptDenied when creating envelope`

maria-sec: We deployed a stricter S3 endpoint policy to only allow bucket ACLs from trusted-logs earlier. That policy inadvertently blocks the audit-shipper proxy which needs to PUT logs and uses the signing role that performs KMS encrypt.

audit-bot: shipper: failed PUT /eu-logs/model-fetch/2026/03/24 403 (endpoint-policy)

leo-ops: So nodes can't fetch artifacts -> join fails -> autoscaler spins more warm nodes in us-west as fallback. Cost hit and latency for jobs. Ops numbers: +22% forecast for next 12h if this persists.

ops-bot: Alert: eu-gpu-pool size down 62% (expected 8 -> 3). Fallback capacity used: 2x reserved in usw2. Estimated egress & spot cost delta: +$5.2k/day.

ayn-sre: Quick mitigations? We can: 1) add audit-shipper signer role ARN to S3 endpoint allowlist 2) add temporary KMS key grant for signer role 3) roll back endpoint policy. Least blasty?

maria-sec: Adding signer role to endpoint policy is lowest blast radius. I'll patch to allow `arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/audit-shipper-signer`.

leo-ops: Patch please, then we'll kick a canary nodejoin. Also add a smoke test to fetch from model bucket.

maria-sec: Running internal patch:
```
aws ec2 modify-vpc-endpoint --vpc-endpoint-id vpce-0abc --add-policy "{\"Statement\":[{\"Effect\":\"Allow\",\"Principal\":{\"AWS\":\"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/audit-shipper-signer\"},\"Action\":\"s3:PutObject\",\"Resource\":\"arn:aws:s3:::eu-logs/*\"}]}"
```

maria-sec: Patch applied. Audit-shipper back to ACCEPT.

audit-bot: shipper: PUT /eu-logs/model-fetch/2026/03/24 200 (ok)

ayn-sre: Requeued a canary join: node-join-7 succeeded. Re-running join workflow across the pool.

nina-ml: Heads-up - training queues saw three preempts; I'm pacing reschedules to avoid concurrent job starts.

ops-bot: Pool restored to 8/8. Cost projection normalized. :white_check_mark:

leo-ops: Follow-ups: - add signer ARN to endpoint change checklist - add KMS grant exercise in deploy CI - create low-risk rollback play for endpoint policies (quick revert flag) - run an offline audit to find other endpoint policies that might block shipper roles.

maria-sec: Will create a short runbook entry: "If S3 endpoint policy blocks shipper, add signer role or create temporary KMS grant; avoid full rollback during business hours."

ayn-sre: Also adding an automated canary that performs model-bucket GET + log PUT after any endpoint policy change.

leo-ops: Thanks. Closing thread for now — reopen if any nodes re-fail. :thumbsup:
